messages:
maria.c: Quick heads-up — hitting aud mismatch errors on long-lived streaming connections when using service-account JWTs across org boundaries. Node client terminates the stream, Python client resumes. Anyone seen this?
eugene: What does the error look like? Can you paste the auth log lines? My hunch: aud is being set to the OAuth token endpoint instead of our inference resource.
sophia: We added an audience normalization toggle in SDK v0.25.0 — if you pass client.opts.audienceOverride it forces the aud to the resource. That could explain language diffs (different SDK defaults).
maria.c: Here's the log snippet: `401 unauthorized: invalid_audience — expected https://inference.redwood.ai, got https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token`
rahul: FYI Rust's oauth validator is stricter by default (crate: sa_auth). If you do service-account impersonation you must pass the final target_audience during the token exchange, otherwise the signed JWT aud will be the token endpoint.
jen: Go client hit the same bug last month — we added a branch that inspects grant_type and forwards an audience param when present. Patch landed in #3421.
sam: Quick Node workaround: set `auth.audienceOverride = 'https://inference.redwood.ai/v1'` when you construct the client. Example: ```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({auth:{audienceOverride: 'https://inference.redwood.ai/v1'}})
```
auth-bot: publish notice: SDK v0.25.1 to npm (2026-02-28) includes audienceOverride and a streaming reconnect fix.
maria.c: Thanks — follow-up question: what's the recommended pattern for long-running streams + reauth? We're seeing jittery reconnects during refresh windows.
sophia: We recommend short refresh windows with graceful reconnect. Use the SDK streaming options: `streaming.reauthGrace=30s` and `streaming.reconnectBackoff = 'exp(100ms,5s)'`. Also enable kv-cache checkpointing so you can resume without losing context.
rahul: Rust-specific note: avoid recreating the TLS context on every token swap; prefer token hot-swap over new TCP/TLS handshakes if server supports it. That reduces reauth blips.
jen: Also check infra LB settings — if your load balancer drains connections during token swaps you'll see mid-stream 502s. Disable aggressive connection draining for inference endpoints.
maria.c: OK will try audienceOverride + reauthGrace + check LB settings. Will report back after tests. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
